result.topic_en: Two theorems: one on conjugate semi-axes and eccentricity of an ellipse expressed with complex numbers, and one on recovering the true chord distance between two points on a sphere from the distance of their stereographic projections.

items.quote:
Sind $t, t'$ die complexen Werthe zweier conjugirten
Halbaxen einer Ellipse und $\varepsilon$ der complexe
Werth der Excentricität (Abstand eines Brennpunkts)
so ist
$tt + t't' = \varepsilon\varepsilon$
items.english: If t, t' are the complex values of two conjugate semi-axes of an ellipse and ε is the complex value of the eccentricity (the distance of a focus), then tt + t't' = εε.

items.quote:
Die wirkliche (geradlinigte) Distanz zweier Punkte
auf der Kugelfläche findet sich aus der Distanz ihrer
stereographischen Projectionen
items.english: The actual (straight-line) distance between two points on the sphere is found from the distance of their stereographic projections, by multiplying the latter by the product of the two cosines of the inclinations to the normal of the lines drawn from those projections to the endpoint of a normal erected at the centre and equal to the diameter of the sphere.

items.quote:
Besser ists entweder die
Projection durch bicomplexe Grössen $t, t'$ auszudrücken
wo die Distanz d. Tangente d. halben Bogens gemessen durch $\frac{t'-t}{1+tt'}$
dargestellt wird; oder sich auch der tricomplexen Grössen
dabei zu bedienen.
items.english: It is better either to express the projection by bicomplex quantities t, t', where the distance, measured by the tangent of the half arc, is represented by (t'-t)/(1+tt'), or else to use tricomplex quantities for this.
